info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Information Provider Administration API
info.description: The Information Provider Administration API enables users to update configurations and settings for external agencies in the banking sector. This API is designed for administrators who manage information provider data, allowing for efficient modifications and enhancements to existing entries. Typical consumers include banking institutions and their IT departments seeking to ensure accurate and up-to-date information management. Through this API, organizations can maintain compliance and improve operational efficiency by effectively managing their external agency partnerships.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of an Information Provider in the External Agency's administration system. Ensure that the provided fields are valid and conform to the expected data format for successful updates.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the information of the external agency with ID RES-100045. It requires a JSON payload that adheres to the specified schema for successful processing.
